run_RayTracing_forward: run the RayTracing forward pass to find ray intersections with an implicit SDF surface
run_RayTracing_sphere_tracing: run the sphere tracing algorithm from both ends of a ray to find surface intersections
run_RayTracing_ray_sampler: run the ray sampler to find sign transitions on non-convergent rays using uniform intervals
run_RayTracing_secant: run the secant method to refine intersection point estimates between two SDF bracketing values
run_get_sphere_intersection: run the sphere intersection calculation to find where rays enter and exit a bounding sphere
